4154.title: ACP probe failure stops later model discovery
4154.rootCauseOneLine: One catch surrounds the sequential model probe loop, so a rejected probe stops later models and leaves them on the medium fallback.

prReviews.verdict: Addresses root cause — static review only
prReviews.topFinding: Per-model catch continues after rejected requests; branch was not executed.

4154.proposedFix: Handle rejection per model, log the model ID, and continue within the existing deadline.
4154.caveats: Synthetic ACP reproduction; real account rate limiting and database persistence were not exercised.
